verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of Bento's own telemetry or usage tracking, whether in the SDK, CLI or dashboard. The only near match is the option to "skip the analytics layer" when exporting via OpenTelemetry (bentolabs-docs-20), but that is a trace-routing choice, not an opt-out of vendor telemetry. The axis applies to an SDK/CLI product like this, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
